title: Prove sharp support28 five-endpoint P112 shortening
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Five-endpoint P112 shortening: sufficient common support <=26 (PR3211)
+ Sharp common-support threshold: 28
+ Actual independent-piece counterexample at 29, with four code dimensions
```

Prove the characteristic-zero support28 theorem and its sharpness in one isolated package, `research/p112-a4-orthogonal-threshold/`. An A4 Parseval argument bounds the orthogonal puncture's cost by 13, forcing `101>100` endpoint incidences at 28. The literal support29 witness has endpoint supports `20,19,20,20,20`, nine independent pieces and exact code intersection dimension 4.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3211 for support26, A4 normalization/spectrum and its two historical profile exclusions; PR3207 for the A5 Parseval method; DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the retained E8/P112 decoder lineage. Exact heads, byte-identical geometry origin, proof, witness, checks and reproduction instructions are committed. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Evidence

- Before, the arbitrary-puncture bound at 28 is 98 and gives no contradiction. After, orthogonality gives 101 against allowance 100. At29, the actual witness attains total support 99 and code intersection 4.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes both exact checkers and thirteen optimized behavioral groups. Separate lattice/frame/modular checks cover all 390,625 lattice candidates and 2,025 orthogonal frames. Exact relations supply the modular checker's rational upper bound.
- Two read-only internal reviews found no blocker. CPython 3.13 and an additional internal CPython 3.15 read-only Git-free replay pass. All 17 publication-byte comparisons and the exact final committed-export replay pass.
- Reproduce: `TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-a4-orthogonal-threshold`, after creating the external `$RUN/tmp` directory. See the package README for the complete command.

The real Weyl-chamber theorem remains a written dependency. This is a local decoder-proof improvement; no new historical TWOSIDE exclusion, full C5, decoder floor, supplier or kappa is claimed. The witness's endpoint binary ranks are seven, so it is not a rank-six TWOSIDE realization. Hosted CI and human/proof-kernel review are separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only the new package is changed. The selected record, shared tools and frozen predecessors are unchanged.
